question: Among users located in the United Kingdom who posted in 2010, find the display name of the owner of the post with the highest favorite count. Only consider posts that have received at least one vote of type 2 (upvote), and ensure the post is not closed.

prediction.sql: SELECT T1."XCL_055" FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1."XCL_052" = T2."XCL_033" WHERE T1."XCL_058" = 'United Kingdom' AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2."XCL_029") = '2010' AND T2."XCL_044" IS NULL AND T2."XCL_026" IN (SELECT T3."XCL_067" FROM votes AS T3 WHERE T3."XCL_068" = 2) ORDER BY T2."XCL_039" DESC LIMIT 1

eligibility.predicate: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM votes WHERE votes.XCL_067 = posts.XCL_026 AND votes.XCL_068 = 2)

arguments.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_055"
FROM users AS T1
INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1."XCL_052" = T2."XCL_033"
WHERE T1."XCL_058" = 'United Kingdom'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2."XCL_029") = '2010'
  AND T2."XCL_044" IS NULL
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM votes AS T3
    WHERE T3."XCL_067" = T2."XCL_026"
      AND T3."XCL_068" = 2
  )
ORDER BY T2."XCL_039" DESC
LIMIT 1
